body:
CONTEXT
ROADMAP.md D1, L1127-1134: "Schema staging, so that no change tests against a schema that does not exist yet and no schema requires a field before the change that emits it: STEP 0 publishes both schema files describing v2.11.0 output exactly (the review result as emitted today, i.e. schema.json plus optional `corroborated_by`; and today's loop events with today's `exitReason` values), and the step 0 parity suite validates every emitted document and event line against them." L1235-1236: "Tests validate EVERY line emitted in every loop parity row against the event schema, and every non-loop `--json` output against the output schema." Both schemas are strict (`additionalProperties: false`, L1138). Later changes extend them (delta 21 adds `validated`; delta 24 makes `loop_summary.survivingCount` integer|null and adds `review-error`; step 3 adds `meta`, error objects, nullable `loop_start.fixerCmd`/`constraintMode`, `quorum-unmet`/`not-independent`; A9 adds `verification_status`) - NONE of that is in this ticket (L145-147). Depends on T50 (harness) for the real-output check AC6.

BASELINE: the schemas describe what release 2.11.1 emits. 2.11.1 is v2.11.0 plus the #66 fix, which changed no emitted shape, so every "v2.11.0" behavior cited here holds. Cited line numbers are approximate: locate each emit site by the named symbol, which is authoritative. Cite the ROADMAP by section heading (ROADMAP.md, "D1. Reviewer provenance", schema staging paragraph), not by line.

GOAL
Two strict JSON Schema files at the repo root that describe exactly what v2.11.0 emits, a dependency-free test-local validator able to check them, and helpers assertValidOutput(doc) / assertValidEvents(lines) that T52-T54 call on every row.

WHAT TODAY EMITS (verify every field against the cited emit sites; do not trust this list blindly)
- Non-loop `--json` document: bin/cli.js L428-429 (single) and ~L172 (multi): schema.json's top-level properties verdict, summary, coverage, findings, next_steps; findings items as schema.json (which already declares optional `corroborated_by`, array of string), including `confidence` with minimum 0 and maximum 1 (schema.json L131).
- Loop NDJSON (src/loop.js emitEvent ~L152-154): loop_start {type, scope, fixerCmd, constraintMode, loopMax, branch?, originalHead?} (~L1000-1006, ~L1533); review {type, iteration, findingCount}; review_result {type, iteration, result: review-result object | null}; stash_created {type, stashRef, stashName, recoveryCmd} (~L1240); fix {type, iteration, fixerCmd, filesTargeted, filesModified?, stashRef?} (~L1305-1311, ~L1702); fix_committed {type, iteration, commit, beforeFixHead} (~L1754); loop_end {type, exitReason, iterations, stashRef?, originalHead?, matchedIteration?, fixerStderr?} - several sites emit `stashRef: null`, so its type is string|null; fixerStderr is the fixer's captured stderr (src/loop.js L1343 `fixerStderr: fixerResult.stderr`), type string (possibly empty; confirm whether it can be undefined/absent); loop_summary from buildLoopSummary (~L166-182) {type, providers, iterations, verdict, exitReason, survivingCount (integer), acceptedCount, resumeHint?}. resumeHint is an OBJECT {cli: string, id: string, command: string} with additionalProperties:false (src/resume-hint.js L64 `return { cli, id, command: ... }`), or absent; confirm whether null is ever emitted and allow it only if so. exitReason enum today: clean, empty, no-progress, ceiling, fixer-error, fixer-timeout, no-diff.

VALIDATOR
src/schema-validate.js (validateAgainstSchema) supports type/required/properties/additionalProperties/enum/items/minimum/maximum/minLength, but no `oneOf`, `const`, or type arrays, and it is production code that must not change here. Write test/parity/helpers/schema-lite.mjs supporting exactly: type (string or array, incl. 'null' and 'integer'), enum, const, required, properties, additionalProperties:false, items, oneOf (exactly one branch must match), minimum, maximum, minLength. It THROWS on any keyword it does not recognise other than $schema, $id, $comment, description, title (so an unsupported keyword can never be silently ignored). No new npm dependency.

DECISIONS (P0, 2026-10-06)
- Both schema files are added to package.json `files`, so they ship in the npm tarball from the next release. test/packaging.test.js asserts that `npm pack --dry-run --json` lists both.
- loop-events-schema.json embeds its own copy of the review-result schema (no $ref). A test asserts the embedded copy deep-equals output-schema.json, so they cannot drift, and schema-lite needs no $ref support.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA
AC1  output-schema.json exists at the repo root, is valid JSON, and equals schema.json's top-level structure (same required keys, same property set, same findings item properties including optional corroborated_by, same minimum/maximum on confidence), with additionalProperties:false on every object. Verified by test/parity/schemas.test.mjs: a structural comparison against schema.json that fails if any property set or bound differs (negative control: the comparison applied to a copy of schema.json with one added property reports a difference).
AC2  loop-events-schema.json exists at the repo root: a oneOf with one variant per event type listed above, discriminated by a required `type` const, every variant additionalProperties:false, exitReason enum exactly [clean, empty, no-progress, ceiling, fixer-error, fixer-timeout, no-diff], survivingCount integer, resumeHint object {cli,id,command}, review_result.result = (review-result schema inlined) | null. Verified in schemas.test.mjs by validating one hand-written valid example per event type (zero errors), and by a test that the inlined review-result copy deep-equals output-schema.json.
AC3  Strictness negative controls, each asserting a non-empty error list: (a) loop_summary with an extra `validated` key, (b) loop_summary with `meta`, (c) loop_end with exitReason "review-error", (d) loop_summary with survivingCount null, (e) loop_start with fixerCmd null, (f) a non-loop document with a `meta` key, (g) a finding with `verification_status`, (h) an event with an unknown `type`, (i) a finding with confidence 1.5, (j) loop_summary with resumeHint as a string. Verified in schemas.test.mjs.
AC4  schema-lite.mjs unit tests: each supported keyword (incl. maximum) has one passing and one failing case; oneOf with zero matches and with two matches both fail; a schema using an unsupported keyword (e.g. `pattern`) makes the validator throw. Verified in schemas.test.mjs.
AC5  assertValidOutput(doc) and assertValidEvents(lines) are exported from test/parity/helpers/schema-lite.mjs, throw with the validator's error list on failure, and have one passing and one failing call each. Verified in schemas.test.mjs.
AC6  Real-output check (uses T50's runCli): schemas.test.mjs validates (a) the stdout of `--provider claude --json` with an APPROVE and with a FLAG mock response, and (b) every NDJSON line of a working-tree `--loop --json --loop-unsafe` run that converges after one fix (anthropic stub reviewer FLAG then APPROVE, codex mock fixer), asserting zero errors. Verified by `node --test test/parity/schemas.test.mjs`.
AC7  Publication: both files are added to package.json `files`, and test/packaging.test.js gains an assertion that they are listed (additive edit only). Verified by `node --test test/packaging.test.js` and `npm pack --dry-run 2>&1 | grep -E 'output-schema.json|loop-events-schema.json'`.
AC8  No production change: `git diff --exit-code HEAD -- bin src schema.json skills prompt-template.md prompt-template-artifact.md test/parity/helpers/harness.mjs test/parity/helpers/mock-cli.mjs test/parity/helpers/http-stub.mjs test/parity/helpers/mutant.mjs test/parity/helpers/rows.mjs` is empty. Verified by that command and rails-guard.

NON-GOALS
- No `meta`, `validated`, `verification_status`, error-object variants, or new exitReasons (those land with D1/delta 21/delta 24/A9).
- No change to schema.json or src/schema-validate.js. No runtime use of these schemas by the CLI.

VERIFICATION COMMAND
node --test test/parity/schemas.test.mjs test/packaging.test.js && npm test
title: Publish 2.11.1 output-schema.json and loop-events-schema.json plus a test-local strict validator (ROADMAP step 0 schema staging)
